description: (Na)₂NdCuCl₆ is alpha Rhenium trioxide-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a NdCuCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NdCuCl₆ framework, Nd is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NdCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CuCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Nd-Cl bond lengths are 2.71 Å. Cu is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form CuCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NdCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Cu-Cl bond lengths are 2.51 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Nd and one Cu atom.
